change.behavior: Resolve the mapped parameter slot before scanning active frames and return immediately for ordinary arrays, unmapped arguments, deleted mappings, or out-of-range indices. The existing mapped-object synchronization path is unchanged.
change.binding_time: The arguments_map is attached only to mapped arguments objects at activation creation; ordinary arrays and unmapped arguments cannot acquire it.

production_build.command: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo build --locked --profile production -p quench-runtime --bin quench
production_build.comparison: The binaries were built from the same dirty source tree and toolchain; only the early-return change in arguments.rs differed.

paired_microbenchmark.bootstrap: 100000 paired resamples of per-round candidate/baseline deltas; median and percentile 95% interval; seed 61102027
paired_microbenchmark.workload: An existing dense Array is updated and read over 4000x2500 iterations (10,000,000 indexed stores), inside a function whose ordinary argument local aliases the Array. This exercises the generic array-store path that previously scanned active frames looking for mapped arguments.

preexisting_nested_alias_mismatch.note: The pre-existing frame scan treats any frame holding the arguments object as its owner and can overwrite an unrelated local. This behavior is unchanged by the fast-return optimization and remains a separate correctness issue.
